title: Bubble dynamics and vortex formation in holographic first-order superfluid phase transitions
summary: We investigate bubble dynamics in a holographic superfluid undergoing a first-order phase transition with spontaneous $U(1)$ symmetry breaking. Near the nucleation threshold, the system exhibits universal critical behavior governed by a single unstable mode, leading to logarithmic scaling of the time spent near the critical solution. The terminal bubble wall velocity increases with charge density but remains small due to strong dissipation.
